title: Aaron Rodgers can't guarantee post-retirement return to Green Bay, hints at lingering tension with 'certain people in the building'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers can't guarantee post-retirement return to Green Bay, hints at lingering tension with 'certain people in the building'
sources.description: Rodgers believes that there are people in the Packers facility who wouldn't entirely welcome a reunion: "Maybe I wouldn't be on board if they were still there as well."
